title: Seventeen Months and One Jammed Gate
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：difficulty　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 difficulty 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the foreman ① met a difficulty that no engineer in the yard would have admitted, and he said the meeting was the whole of the shift. The ② difficulty, meaning the trouble and not the hardship, ran seventeen months and stayed unrecorded on the board; a difficulty, he said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left unsolved.

Every ③ difficulty in that yard had the same jammed gate at the end of it, and the ④ difficulty at the end, meaning the one they kept for the winter deliveries and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever solved twice. A difficulty, his mate said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to meet; the foreman said the patience is the part that fills seventeen months.

The inspector meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the difficulty was the whole of the report, meaning the hardship and not the trouble. The ⑥ difficulty, meaning the hardship and not any of that, is the only thing in a report that everybody cites and nobody relieves; difficulty, she said, is either something you meet or the only word that means both a trouble and a hardship. She said the hardship is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ difficulty had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the jammed gate. The ⑧ difficulty of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in March, was one yard and seventeen months of meeting; difficulty, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to meet. She said the meeting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ difficulty I remember is the one at the end, which was cleared in 1975 and is still described as the strangest in the yard. A ⑩ difficulty, his mate said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being solved; every difficulty, she said, is a hardship that has agreed to look like a trouble. She said the hardship was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 困难；难题（指厂院里遇到的那一个）
B. n. 难题（指那个麻烦本身，与那种艰难相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet a difficulty 应对一个难题
D. n. 难题（指留给冬季送货用的那一个）
E. n. 困难；难事（抽象总称，指一处厂院的全部麻烦）
F. n. 困难（指日志里记入、被登记的那一个）
G. n. 艰难；困苦（指报告里被引述的那种处境）
H. n. 艰难（抽象总称，指人人援引却无人缓解的那种）

items.q: met a difficulty that no engineer in the yard would have admitted
The difficulty, meaning the trouble and not the hardship
the difficulty was the whole of the report
the difficulty had become a line in a logbook
The difficulty of the whole thing
A difficulty, his mate said in 1977

answers.why: meet a difficulty 意为“应对一个难题”，1950 年工头应对了一个厂院里没有一位工程师肯承认的难题。
difficulty 意为“难题”，指那个麻烦本身而不是那种艰难，它在公告板上挂了十七个月而没有记录。
difficulty 意为“困难、难题”，指那处厂院里每一个难题，每一个末尾都有同一扇卡住的门。
difficulty 意为“难题”，指留给冬季送货用的那一个，是唯一有人解决过两次的。
difficulty 意为“艰难、困苦”，指报告里被引述的那种处境，视察员说这种艰难就是那份报告的全部。
difficulty 意为“艰难”，指人人援引却无人缓解的那种而不是那个麻烦本身，是报告里人人都援引、却无人缓解的东西。
difficulty 意为“困难”，指日志里记入、被登记的那一个，到 1958 年这个难题成了日志里的一行。
difficulty 意为“困难、难事”，工头三月写道，整件事的麻烦是一处厂院和十七个月的应对。
difficulty 意为“难题”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1975 年被解决，至今仍被说成厂院里最奇的一个。
difficulty 为抽象总称，工友 1977 年说，一个难题是唯一会因为被解决而变得更好的东西。
